kind.value: Social scheduler built around recurring, one-time and seasonal content libraries, with bulk scheduling and automation integrations

pricingModel.value: Plan tiers with included accounts and users; extra accounts $4/month and teammates $20/month

trial.value: 14 days on self-serve plans; no credit card required

plans.value: Monthly: Starter $9 (2 accounts, 1 user, 10 daily posts/account); Personal $25 (5, 1, 20); Agency $79 (20, 3, 80). Enterprise custom for 100+ accounts. Annual billing gives two months free; taxes extra
plans.note: The pricing page also lists a $0.20 charge per X post containing a link, funded through an X Wallet.

networks.value: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Google Business Profile, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube, Threads and Bluesky
networks.note: Facebook Groups, Facebook personal profiles and Instagram personal profiles use push notifications with mobile confirmation.

api.value: Public API documented for accounts, workspaces, libraries, posting, scheduling, history and AI generation; authenticates with a separate API Password Key

mcp.value: Official recurpost-mcp server, available on every plan; tools cover accounts, workspaces, posting, libraries, history and AI
mcp.note: Its MIT license applies to the connector, not a self-hosted RecurPost application.

teams.value: Per-client workspaces, shareable no-login calendars, editable roles and permissions; configurable post approval stages are on Agency
